stories.title: Scheffler reasserts No. 1 status with 2nd Cup win
stories.summary: Scottie Scheffler held off Viktor Hovland in a back-nine duel to win his second FedEx Cup in three years.

stories.title: Tour Championship 2026: Top moments as Scottie Scheffler earns the victory
stories.summary: The Tour Championship concluded on Sunday with Scottie Scheffler winning. Here are all the best moments from his victory.

stories.title: Star DT Donald unretires to rejoin loaded Rams
stories.summary: Star defensive tackle Aaron Donald is coming out of retirement to try to help the Rams win another Super Bowl. He agreed to a one-year, $20 million deal, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and the NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Jacobs put on exempt list as Pack trade for RB
stories.summary: The NFL has placed Packers running back Josh Jacobs on the commissioner exempt list.

stories.title: OBJ earns spot on Giants' initial 53-man roster
stories.summary: Wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. has made the Giants' initial 53-man roster after a season out of the NFL.
